verdict.rationale: Codex is explicitly designed as a natural-language coding agent — docs describe delegating tasks, prompting with images, interactive composer, and CLI chat sessions (codex-docs-6, -9, -12, -13, -19), and community reports confirm real-world use of NL prompts to drive edits and fixes (codex-comm-8, -14, -18), though some users note it requires more explicit prompting on lighter models (codex-comm-15).
